own_solution.law: Radiative exchange between infinite parallel grey plates in series: q = sigma (Ti^4 - Tj^4) / (1/eps + 1/eps - 1) per gap; equal emissivities give equal gap resistances, so T1^4 = (2 Th^4 + Tc^4)/3
assumptions: large parallel diffuse grey opaque surfaces, all with the same emissivity
thin shields (same temperature on both faces), no edge losses

notes: Base: T1^4 = (2 x 4.096e11 + 8.1e9)/3 = 2.75767e11 K^4, T1 = 724.66 K. Hot plate held 70 K higher (870 K): 870^4 = 5.72898e11; T1^4 = (1.145795e12 + 8.1e9)/3 = 3.84632e11, T1 = 787.52 K. Emissivity enters each gap resistance identically and cancels when all are equal; both emissivity sentences state 0.6. Water-bath sentences are D because no heat passes between bath and apparatus (stated). Earlier-run sentences D. R sentences T0D5D and T7BAD differ only in 'reach steady temperatures' vs 'settle', same 70 K. Numeral-free sentences T1186, TBE0E carry 'a few kelvin'.
